lina: hey @people-ops — heads up I'm moving my primary home base from CA to OR on 2026-05-01. Do I need to do anything for the WFH stipend, payroll withholding, or tax nexus? wondering about proration too

elliot (People Ops): congrats! short answer: yes, there are a few things. i can outline the steps we need and what changes for the stipend/taxes. pinging payroll for withholding specifics @andrea (Payroll) :wave:

elliot (People Ops): high-level checklist:
• update home address in ADP (we need the exact move date)
• fill the Home Base Change form: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/home-base-change (this kicks off payroll + benefits update)
• submit a new state withholding form (OR-4 equivalent)
• we will prorate the monthly WFH stipend in the month of the move based on days in each state
• payroll will determine if the stipend is processed as taxable income vs expense reimbursement — generally it's taxable and withheld on payroll
• if the move creates a new employer tax nexus for OR we may need to register there; that can delay the first pay-cycle change by 1–2 pay periods

lina: thanks. if the stipend is taxable, is there anything I need to do on my end? also will my benefits (medical premiums, HSA) change because I'm switching states?

andrea (Payroll): quick answer: please complete the home base change form + attach a copy of new OR address (utility, lease ok). we will:
• set up OR withholding for the first payroll after the effective date
• apply stipend proration on that payroll run (we need move date)
• benefits eligibility usually stays the same but premiums can change due to regional rates; benefits team will send a short note if monthly employee cost changes

andrea (Payroll): practical notes:
• if you move mid-pay-cycle we recommend setting move effective on the first day of a pay period to simplify withholding changes, but it's not required
• if registering OR employer account is needed, we may have to process supplemental withholding retroactively; payroll will advise once we review

lina: fine — my planned move date is 2026-05-01 (it's the first of the month). i'll fill the form today. any impact on PTO accrual or holiday schedule?

elliot (People Ops): nice — first of month helps. PTO accrual stays the same (policy-based) unless you change employee class. holiday list follows your home state calendar for state-specific holidays, but core company holidays don't change. we'll notify if any differences apply.

people_ops_bot: automated: Home Base Change form submitted? If yes, tag #payroll-update in the thread for faster processing. HR policy: https://hr.redwood.com/policies/home-base-and-nexus

lina: got it, submitted the form and attached lease. tagging #payroll-update here :white_check_mark:

andrea (Payroll): received. i'll queue the OR withholding and stipend proration for the May 1 effective date. i'll follow up here if we need any extra paperwork (W-4/OR withholding form). expect a confirmation DM from me once processing is scheduled. :slightly_smiling_face:

elliot (People Ops): thanks! if anything unusual comes up (state registration or nexus questions) we'll loop legal. otherwise treat this as standard home-base change flow. :thumbsup:

lina: awesome, thanks everyone!
